2609.02011.title: Seed-Anchored Budget-Bounded Graph Rendering for Question Answering on Industry-Standard Power-Grid Information and Exchange Models
2609.02011.paper_summary: Large language model question answering over power-grid models must respect a fixed context budget. We introduce seed-anchored graph rendering, a deterministic method that prioritizes query-local graph evidence without adding method-specific tuned or learned parameters beyond the shared hop bound and context budget. The method provides a checkable condition under which predefined seed-local answer-bearing render units are preserved in a greedy bounded-context prefix. We evaluate the approach on Common Information Model (CIM) network models exchanged through the Common Grid Model Exchange Standard (CGMES). On two budget-binding CGMES encodings, naive descriptions-first rendering retains local evidence for every single-hop item but only 0.12 and 0.00 of multi-hop items, whereas seed-anchored rendering retains all such evidence. On a preregistered fresh 100-item bank from the SmallGrid topology family, accuracy rises from 0.450 to 0.970 under a fixed 8,000-character context budget. Under a common retrieval and rendering pipeline, the standards-native seed-anchored graph matches or exceeds extracted graph representations produced by LightRAG, Microsoft GraphRAG, and HippoRAG, while avoiding LLM graph-construction tokens. The results are specific to the evaluated CIM/CGMES models, reader, and context budget; they concern budget-bounded retrieval rather than general question answering.
2609.02011.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在電力網模型上的問答必須遵循固定的上下文預算。<lb/>我們引入了種子錨定圖形渲染，這是一種確定性方法，優先考慮查詢局部圖形證據，而不添加超出共享跳數限制和上下文預算的特定於方法的調整或學習參數。<lb/>該方法提供了一個可檢查的條件，在該條件下，預定義的種子局部答案承載渲染單元在貪婪的有界上下文前綴中得以保留。<lb/>我們在通用信息模型（CIM）網絡模型上評估該方法，這些模型通過通用電網模型交換標準（CGMES）進行交換。<lb/>在兩個預算約束的CGMES編碼上，天真的描述優先渲染為每個單跳項保留局部證據，但僅為多跳項保留0.12和0.00，而種子錨定渲染則保留所有這些證據。<lb/>在來自SmallGrid拓撲系列的預註冊新100項目庫中，準確率在固定的8000字符上下文預算下從0.450上升到0.970。<lb/>在一個通用的檢索和渲染管道下，標準原生的種子錨定圖形匹配或超過了由LightRAG、Microsoft GraphRAG和HippoRAG生成的提取圖形表示，同時避免了LLM圖形構建標記。<lb/>這些結果特定於評估的CIM/CGMES模型、讀者和上下文預算；它們關注於預算約束的檢索，而不是一般的問答。
